issues.summary: The host renderer sampled seven complete margin tiles at arbitrary sub-tile scroll phases, but the cartridge initializer and moving-row sweep prepared only six. The uninitialized seventh physical BG1 ring column could later rotate into the native center as one 8-pixel vertical strip of stale terrain.

issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-16 first by restoring the 56-pixel experimental cartridge contract, then superseded by the safer stock-cartridge default after cross-level fresh-entry testing proved the widened initializer itself corrupts some layouts. Host ROM prefill plus stock streaming retains the accepted 809-frame and 3559-frame Jungle framebuffer hashes; the widened path is now research-only.

issues.summary: Jungle Hijinxs Bonus 1 lost its purple floor and showed checkerboard cave columns because a shared fixed-layout initializer was incorrectly treated as a rolling-terrain widescreen capability and wrote widened columns into the native VRAM ring.
issues.expected: Mode $0001, level $0009, entrance $0006 keeps the cartridge initializer stock; the host handles only the side presentation, and a fresh route renders the complete cave floor without changing ordinary scrolling terrain.
issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-16 by making stock cartridge initialization/row streaming the global fail-closed default; the old widening is research-only behind DKC1_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_CARTRIDGE_WIDENING=1. Three 3589-frame fresh-entry replays restore the cave floor, while a separate authentic Ropey Rampage A/B proves the same containment restores its full terrain. Binaries from 05:44 through the pre-rowfix 08:11 build reproduce the old corruption, locating the broad policy to commit 6bf8981 rather than the later seven-tile change.

issues.summary: Underwater level $0061/$80BF stayed entirely 4:3 because the host decoded both level-map cells and metatile definitions from the map bank. This scene publishes map bank $E9 in $D5 and metatile-definition bank $D0 in $D6, so the one-bank decode failed calibration and correctly fell back to pillarbox.
issues.expected: ROM level decoding reads map cells from $D5 and metatile definitions from $D6, includes both banks in source identity/trace evidence, and widens only after the native rolling tilemap calibration passes.
issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-16 by splitting the decoder inputs. The exact state improved vertical calibration from 50/224 to 212/224, selected the vertical layout, and rendered real terrain on both sides. Three independent 120-frame candidate replays are byte-identical (frame 54d5958e..., WRAM abf22673..., VRAM 24481010...).

issues.summary: Croctopus Chase level $0061/$00BF widened correctly, but its lower-right rock wall stopped at the native edge and exposed BG2 water in the right margin. The ROM map itself switches from a fully populated wall metatile at world X $0620-$063F to wholly transparent metatiles at X $0640 because those cells were never visible on stock hardware.
issues.expected: Only wholly transparent 32x32 metatiles beyond the native right edge continue the nearest fully populated wall boundary. Native pixels, cartridge memory, partial openings, and every other level remain unchanged.
issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-16 with a scene-locked, presentation-only vertical-boundary continuation. The exact frame replaces 96 transparent margin tiles; WRAM, VRAM, CGRAM, and both OAM copies remain byte-identical. The 256px native center matches its oracle at all 57,344 pixels, three frame captures are byte-identical (SHA-256 AAB0EF0B...), and three 3,551-frame input-history replays end at exact WRAM F5BCA064.... Promoted 2026-08-30 from the Croctopus tuple to a fail-closed vertical-layout capability: a wholly transparent target may continue only from a fully populated source toward the stock edge when an adjacent metatile row proves the same boundary; partial intervening art rejects the continuation.

issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-16 by searching inward only on the right for the nearest complete continuation source. The exact frame continues 93 tiles and changes 1,491 pixels, all in the 43-pixel right margin; the native center and every other plane are exact. Both previously fixed Croctopus boundary states are pixel-identical, native 4:3 is byte-identical on all five captured surfaces, and three candidate composites are byte-identical (SHA-256 0FDA2212...). Promoted 2026-08-30 to the structural vertical-boundary capability; the inward search remains right-margin-only and now rejects partial intervening metatiles and isolated one-row features without consulting scene or ROM-bank IDs.

issues.summary: At world X $0241 in Croctopus Chase level $0061/$00BF, BG1's rock wall stopped 11 pixels inside the left widescreen margin and exposed BG2 water. issues.summary: Slip-Slide Ride mode $0009, level $0051, entrance $006D could replace most of both widescreen margins with adjacent ROM tile columns while the camera moved. Independent floor-division first exposed 1-3 pixel camera smoothing; a later uphill/downhill repro showed that rounding an exact four-pixel half-tile tie away from zero still selected an adjacent column.

issues.expected: The decoder quantizes the signed camera/PPU pixel delta once and resolves a half-tile tie toward zero as a global coordinate-domain conversion, preserving camera smoothing and authored phases without scene IDs or cartridge-state changes.
issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-30 with a presentation-only signed-delta quantizer whose exact half-tile tie resolves toward zero. The original 330-frame A/B reduces world-aligned margin changes from 2,064,024 to 582,396 pixels (71.8%), improves 123 frames, and worsens none; its accepted offsets remain [0,64] for 329 frames and [0,-64] only at the PPU wrap. The later 780-frame uphill/downhill A/B replaces 120 [-1,-32] frames and seven [1,-32] frames with [0,-32] for all 780 frames. It changes 1,666,730 pixels across 129 frames, all in the two presentation margins and zero in the native center; final WRAM and VRAM are byte-identical, and retrodiction mismatches fall from 3,023 to 2,034. Three complete repeats are byte-identical (frame buffer 0010881A..., WRAM 42BAC94E..., VRAM 5F137C81..., CGRAM 33906DBD..., OAM 946088D1..., audio FNV-1a A7ACA5CD19AA7DC1). A controller-only Zinger death followed by map-node re-entry validates a fresh scene boundary: 765 accepted extended frames, 135 fail-closed entry frames, zero raw fallback, and zero policy violations. Promoted globally on 2026-08-30 because subtracting the two cartridge-authentic pixel coordinates before tile quantization is a coordinate-domain rule, not a room capability. Exact underwater and 780-frame cave outputs remain byte-identical to the pre-promotion runner. Four authentic fresh entrances pass three repeats with zero terrain misses, raw fallback, policy violations, or instability, and 12 neutral/Right+Y/Left+Y traversal branches match the pre-promotion runner in framebuffer and all final machine hashes. The available map root exposes only 4 of the 40 floor entrances, so full-matrix promotion remains unclaimed.

issues.summary: At nonzero fine X scroll, the 256-pixel native viewport touches a 33rd BG1 tile, but the generic live shadow sweep retained only 32 complete columns. The renderer's chunk beginning at screen X=254 therefore missed once per scanline and used the transparent fallback across the native/right-margin handoff, producing moving vertical bands in Croctopus Chase and compounding the reported cave-side flicker.
issues.repro: build/repros/underwater-side-flicker-20260830-live/exact-underwater-live.state at absolute frame 312762; baseline-stress reports terrain_margin_miss on all 12 motion actions
issues.expected: A 256-pixel viewport on a wide 8x8 tilemap must capture all live tiles it intersects: 32 columns at phase zero and 33 at every nonzero fine-X phase. The native center, guest memories, camera, streaming, and gameplay logic remain cartridge-authentic.
issues.fixed_note: fixed 2026-08-30 in the shared presentation shadow: its live footprint already computed the fine-scroll overhang but capped storage at 32 columns, so the cap is now 33 for every wide 8x8 tilemap. The byte-exact cartridge source at $81:883F confirms that DKC uploads one 32-word map column only when CameraX & $FFF8 changes; the partially exposed next column is therefore live PPU state, not a reason to alter guest streaming. An engine-level regression proves the second-screen tile at column 33 is retained. The v2 snapshot layout remains fixed at 32 retained columns and recaptures the transient overhang after load, preserving old state compatibility. The exact Croctopus frame drops terrain misses and blank serves from 224 to zero and removes the visible strips; all 129 changed native-center pixels match the 4:3 oracle, while WRAM and VRAM remain exact. Three 720-frame traversal repeats are byte-identical and report zero terrain misses across all 508 accepted wide frames. A controller-only map re-entry gives 626 accepted wide frames with zero misses in each of three repeats. The 12-action, two-repeat arbitrary-state stress suite is clean, native-mode traversal is byte-identical to the pre-change runner, and the 780-frame Slip-Slide Ride cave regression remains zero-miss with byte-identical final frame 0010881A..., WRAM 42BAC94E..., and VRAM 5F137C81.... The available user map state exposed only four unlocked entrance nodes, so the complete 40-entrance capability floor was not rerun; no wider all-layout claim is made.

issues.summary: The fixed 60 Hz game loop is steady, but physical ProMotion scanout can still shift an otherwise complete source frame by one or more 120 Hz intervals. The old window-bound callback no longer advances emulation, so the remaining hitch is isolated to host presentation rather than cartridge timing.
issues.repro: build/repros/macos-metal-pacing-20260830/final-short-visible*/scanout.jsonl with the immutable Slip-Slide Ride state and vertical-left-right/left-right.inputs
issues.expected: Each complete 60 Hz source frame is scanned exactly twice on a 120 Hz panel, with approximately 8.333 ms drawable intervals and approximately 16.667 ms physical source transitions; no missing, backward, or coalesced source frames.
issues.mitigation_note: The 2026-08-30 fixed-clock change removed the measured 29-46 ms game-loop stalls. The follow-up native Metal path keeps emulation at that fixed 60 Hz and uses an independent CAMetalDisplayLink, a three-frame immutable queue, one-frame presentation lead, and two 120 Hz draws per source frame. Sharp Bilinear became the fullscreen default, with Smooth and Pixel Sharp retained as explicit choices. Three 780-frame runs remain byte-identical and the presenter reports no producer drops, consumer skips, missing source frames, backward transitions, or starvation. A clean visible sample held 8.333 ms physical intervals and 16.667 ms source transitions, but other current-build visible samples reached approximately 12 ms p99 drawable intervals and approximately 20.5 ms p99 source transitions even while the CPU loop stayed near 16.667 ms. The new dkc1.scanout.v1 trace records actual drawable presentedTime beside camera and BG1-BG3 scroll so the remaining compositor-level variability can be diagnosed without changing game state.
